differs.mechanic: A horizontal divider steps down the card one row at a time, re-reading each metric as it passes, instead of a vertical divider sweeping fragments into rows.
differs.layout: Copy and the customer quote share a left column beside a tall results card with three stacked metric rows, replacing the heading over a full-width desk-and-table frame.
differs.data: A before / after comparison of three metrics, each with its computed change and a bar that shrinks or grows from a dashed outline of the old value, instead of nine scattered items.
differs.moment: The last row flips to its after value, the grip docks at the card's foot, and an attributed customer quote lands as the closing evidence.

blurb: A before / after divider steps down a card of three metrics, each re-reading with its change, and a customer quote closes the case.
